FleetTask.description: One row per ledger entry a developer's fleet has in flight — the grid's live view of _fleet/local/LEDGER.md, projected up before any commit exists.

ActorPresence.description: One row per developer per repo — is their fleet running right now, on which branch, since when.

HandoffPointer.description: A pointer to (and a digest of) one handoff file — never the handoff body, never file contents. Server-side cell ACL is not fully wired, so a minimal payload is the defense.

RunEventSummary.description: Per-actor, per-run counts reduced from _fleet/local/runs/<actor>-<ts>/events.jsonl — the run event vocabulary from src/compile/telemetry.js, never the raw event stream itself.
